text:
Priya: Heads-up: acme-corp reported p99 spikes on /v1/generate around 2026-03-15T02:14Z. They say latency jumped from ~300ms to 3-5s for a subset of requests. We need a very narrow-slice repro: sampled request ids, HARs, client-side concurrency profile, token counts, and a couple of exact prompt examples.

Sam: Copy. Which exact 10m window and model/route should we focus on? Any already-flagged request ids?

Priya: Window = 2026-03-15T02:10:00Z -> 2026-03-15T02:20:00Z. Route = /v1/generate, model = redwood-13b-v1 (hosted). I pulled a few candidate req ids from the aggregator: req_3a1f2, req_b7c9e, req_4f0d2. Can support collect HARs for those three and ask the customer to run a minimal curl against the same client host? Also request their concurrency profile (threads, qps) and a token matrix for samples.

Jess: On it. Asked customer to capture HARs and to paste back the raw curl output. Requested concurrency details (client threads, per-thread qps) and example prompt inputs. Asked them to include the exact Authorization header masked.

Jess: Example curl I sent them to standardize reproductions:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-v1","input":"<sample prompt>","max_tokens":256}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Alex: I can prepare a narrow-slice loadplan for staging: 50 concurrent clients, ramp 0->50 over 30s, steady 90s, then taper. Token profile to sample: in/out = 32/64, 128/128, 512/128. I'll run vegeta and collect HAR + request ids for every failed/slow request.

Sam: Please ensure the replay sets header `X-Trace-Id: <uuid>` so we can map back to traces easily. Also request eng-sre to pull node-level logs and nvml snapshots for the same window — need GPU throttling/temperature and process-level metrics.

sre-bot: debug-bundle created: https://internal.redwood/debug/2034567890-acme-spike (contains node metrics, scheduler traces, container logs for the time window).

Priya: Perfect. Once we have HARs + raw curl output + vegeta plan + token matrix + request ids, we'll assemble a tiny repro kit for eng-runtime: 1) sample HARs, 2) 3 sample prompt payloads, 3) vegeta script, 4) mapping of request ids -> trace ids -> timestamps. Ask customer whether they had variable bodies (attachments/long contexts) for the flagged requests.

Jess: :thumbsup: pinging customer now. Their ETA for HAR + curl output is ~2-3 hours. I'll paste here when it arrives.

Sam: I'll queue the controlled replay against staging with the identical model variant and quantization flags the customer uses. Note: match sequence-length padding and do kv-cache warmup before measuring. Tag all run IDs with the original req ids.

Priya: If the replay reproduces p95/p99 flares, escalate to eng-runtime with the assembled kit and include a short summary: observed baseline latency, replay profile, and whether CPU/GPU saturation observed. Also include the token distribution histogram (low/med/high) so optimize-tier suggestions are data-driven.

Alex: Will include a small tokenizer token-count table and attach vegeta output + HARs.

Jess: Reporting back once customer artifacts are in.

Priya: Thanks everyone — this narrow-slice approach should keep noise low and make the flake actionable.
